description: $100,000 a year buys about a $337,657 home under the 28/36 rule. This home affordability calculator also applies UAE limits: 50% of salary and an 80% loan. Web page: https://calcbright.com/home-affordability-calculator

costsPct.description: Purchase costs paid in cash (%) DLD 4%, agent 2% + VAT, bank and registration fees – about 7.5% of the price with a mortgage.

debts.description: Monthly debt payments Car, personal and student loans, card minimums – not rent.

income.description: Gross annual income Before tax – in the UAE, gross monthly salary × 12.

pmi.description: PMI rate (under 20% down) (% / yr) Yearly % of the loan; ask your lender for a quote. 0 to ignore.

rules.description: Lender rules UAE banks cap all installments at 50% of salary and the loan at a share of the price; US lenders use DTI guidelines and PMI.
